description: The plot illustrates the training loss over steps for six different model configurations—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Small 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—all trained on a 20M data size. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0K to 440K, with major tick marks at 0K, 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, 420K, 430K, and 440K, indicating a non-uniform scale that compresses the early steps and expands the later ones. The y-axis, labeled “Train Loss,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.85, with grid lines at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. All six lines begin near 0.85 at 0K steps and exhibit a steep decline in loss within the first 20K steps, after which the rate of decline slows. By 80K steps, all lines have converged to values between approximately 0.1 and 0.15. From 80K to 420K steps, the lines remain relatively flat with minor fluctuations, indicating stabilization of training loss. In the final segment from 420K to 440K, all lines show a slight further decrease, settling near 0.05 to 0.1. The ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple) and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown) lines consistently remain at or near the bottom of the group throughout training, suggesting lower training loss compared to the others, while ChemBERTa Small 20M (green) and ChemBART Small 20M (red) show slightly higher loss values in the later stages. All lines are solid with no markers, and the legend clearly maps each color to its corresponding model configuration.
